tau_axis.interpretation: Summit tau CoV ~median is a few percent -> tau is SHARPLY identified (M100 published no per-node CI; tau there was the 'trustworthy' quantity but not tightly constrained). Observability IMPROVED for the parameter.

residual_axis.interpretation: OOS increment R2 ~0 and residual unpredictable OOS -> the unexplained DYNAMICS remain unlearnable even with float temps + co-located power. V1's residual-null CORROBORATED.

decision_gate.headline: Better instrumentation sharply identifies tau but does NOT make the residual learnable: observability gain is in PARAMETER IDENTIFIABILITY, not residual predictability.
